prefab_test_area.name: Prefab test area / a taped piece of floor to build on
prefab_test_area.description: A marked rectangle of empty floor for trying the prefab system. In its middle a pile of prefabs from the timeline, stuck into each other; the pile clears when the visitor steps over the tape. config: length, depth, count, seed, title.

white_block.name: White block / wall slabs that stop nobody
white_block.description: White wall slabs stood close together as one block with no colliders; inside it, coloured primitives standing in each other; a small pagoda at its face shows where to walk in. config: side, height, count, seed, pagoda.

menu_board.name: Menu board / how the in-game menu works
menu_board.description: A standing board with six sticker notes on the in-game menu (open it, its tabs, choose a thing, place it, the belt, this floor) and the four verb badges read from the badge coins, each marked LOCKED or YOURS. Words: commons/data/prefab_test/menu_board.json.
